output_file.description: Output file path for results, mapped to -o flag. If empty, stdout is used.

userlist.description: Path to file containing usernames for brute-force, mapped to -u flag.

passlist.description: Path to file containing passwords for brute-force, mapped to -p flag.

targets.description: List of target addresses or hostnames. These will be joined with commas for the final command argument.
